bullets.text: Enhanced Developer Tools - **Microsoft Store** updates improve onboarding and analytics for app developers.
AI-Ready SIEM Guide - **Microsoft** outlines key features for future-proof security operations centers.
Active Exploitation Alert - **Microsoft Defender** warns of ongoing threats targeting **SolarWinds** Web Help Desk.
Safer Online Learning - **Microsoft Edge** for Business enhances security in K–12 education environments.
Arm Momentum in Japan - **Microsoft's** App Assure supports developers in optimizing apps for Arm-powered PCs.
Secure Boot Updates - **Microsoft** initiates major security updates for **Secure Boot** certificates.
AI Agents on the Rise - **Microsoft** reveals 80% of Fortune 500 companies utilize active AI agents.
AI Recommendation Poisoning - **Microsoft** identifies new threats manipulating AI memory for biased recommendations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and improvements are rolling out in **Windows 11** builds.
User Transparency in Windows - **Microsoft** enhances security through user consent and app behavior visibility.
